notes.title: Over 1,000 Wishlists!
notes.content:
Thank you so much for over a thousand wishlists! This is more than I ever imagined - I am so honored to see that people are excited for my game. I don't take this lightly and am working hard to finish Slackjaw and I really hope you will all enjoy it. Thank you so much for your support!

Be sure to follow me on socials and join the Discord to stay up to date on my progress:

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
Happy Halloween!

Slackjaw is almost at a thousand wishlists - thank you so much, everyone! I am amazed! 

Checkout this new dev log I made updating you on my progress. I am getting so close to finishing! Thinking of possible release dates now...

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VgJCCCOpiIE&t=78s]Youtube Devlog 2[/url]

Have a Happy Halloween and thank you so much for your support! <3 I hope you guys will enjoy the game!

xoxo
-Taylor
